units.source_text: 在从上野站去轻井泽的四个多小时里，一直这样对弈。

en.t: For the more than four hours from Ueno Station to Karuizawa, we went on playing like this the whole time.

units.source_text: 对方输了好几盘却不气馁，我对他这种百折不挠的乐观精神算是折服了。

en.t: Even after losing several games, my opponent did not lose heart, and I found myself admiring his unflagging optimism.

units.source_text: 他那种天真而老实的弱点，倒让我觉得自己像是坏心眼似的。

en.t: His naive and honest vulnerability made me feel, by contrast, as if I were the malicious one.
